prompt: Single game hero sprite: A top-heavy holy knight commander about 2.5 heads tall (huge rounded silver shoulder plates, small head, short legs), wearing silver plate armour with a thin gold edging and a tall silver helmet with one red plume crest; a medium-sized shield with a big gold cross on his LEFT arm, a long straight sword with a gold crossguard held in his RIGHT hand, tilted diagonally upward and forward so its tip stays well inside the frame; a long plain red cape behind him; saturated silver main colour, bright gold accent, red cape. SIDE VIEW from a high top-down camera: a three-quarter view facing RIGHT, as if walking toward the right edge of the screen, the body turned about 30-45 degrees toward the viewer so the face and the front of the chest are visible, the far arm and leg partly hidden behind the body, the weapon held in front on the right side. Neutral ready pose. Not a flat profile, not a front view. The face is only a brow line and a small eye slit; hands are simple mitten shapes, visible and holding the weapon (not hidden in sleeves). No buckles, no pouches, no straps beyond one, no rope, no bandages, no spikes, no stitches, no patches, no fabric texture: clothing is a few big flat shapes. At most three colour families. The weapon and every part of the body stay inside the frame with margin on every side. Background: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no border. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject. Stylized 2D vector cartoon game art for a top-down fantasy tower defense game, designed to read at about 60 pixels tall. Simple design: big clear shapes and a strong silhouette; small details are left out or merged into larger shapes; faces, hands, armour and clothing are suggested with a few lines, never rendered in fine detail. Stylized, exaggerated cartoon proportions, not realistic anatomy (about 2.5 to 4 heads tall): the parts that express the character's role are enlarged and the rest is shrunk, so the silhouette reads at 60 pixels. Colour: flat solid fills only, no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no noise, no realistic rendering. Volume and shadow come from 2-3 hard-edged tones of the same colour (shadow, base, light), plus a few small highlight shapes. Thick clean outlines in a dark shade of the neighbouring colour. Effects are drawn as stacked layers of flat single-colour vector shapes, never as soft blur or gradient glow. High top-down camera tilted about 60 degrees; light comes from the top-left.
